details.effect: [evolve] [cost01]: Evolve this follower. [fanfare] Draw a card. While this card is on your field, each other [dragoncraft] follower on your field has Ward.

issues: The passive Ward aura is encoded with "trait": "Dragoncraft", but the source says each other Dragoncraft follower on your field has Ward. Encode the aura to target other followers by class, e.g. use "cardClass": "dragon" (or an equivalent follower/class filter), not a trait string.
The card should not list "rush" as a keyword; the source text only has [fanfare] Draw a card and no printed Rush keyword.
